content.title: About
content.content: Rum is a distilled spirit made from fermented sugarcane juice or molasses. Diet cola is a calorie‑free soft drink sweetened with artificial sweeteners instead of sugar. The combination is popular in cocktails such as a “Rum‑Cola,” offering a flavorful drink with reduced sugar content.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Rum has a long history dating back to the 17th century, originating in the Caribbean.
Diet cola was first introduced in the 1960s as a response to growing demand for low‑calorie beverages.
The rum‑and‑cola mix became popular in the United States during the 1970s and serves as a base for many bar recipes.
Some countries offer caffeine‑free diet cola, while others include caffeine.
Rum can be light (white) or aged (dark); each type imparts a distinct flavor profile to the cocktail.

items.title: Moderate consumption may promote relaxation
items.content: Small amounts of alcohol have a calming effect, helping to reduce stress.

items.title: Low‑calorie, sugar‑free option
items.content: Diet cola contains no sugar, lowering the overall calorie count compared with regular cola.

items.title: Antioxidants in aged rum
items.content: Aged rum contains trace amounts of polyphenols, which can provide antioxidant benefits.

items.title: Alcohol‑related risks
items.content: Excessive rum consumption can lead to dependence, liver damage, and other health issues.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some individuals may be sensitive to the artificial sweeteners used in diet cola.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Alcohol can amplify the effects of certain medications; consult a healthcare professional if needed.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Combine 50 ml of rum with 150–200 ml of diet cola in a glass over ice. Optionally add a lime wedge or a sprig of mint for extra aroma. Serve immediately while cold.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store rum in a cool, dark place in a tightly sealed bottle for several years. Keep opened diet cola refrigerated to maintain freshness and carbonation.
